name: ambiguous-write-recovery
description: Safely handle write operations whose response may not reveal whether the state change committed.
instructions: Before a retryable write, create one stable idempotency key and reuse the exact same key on every retry.
After a timeout or ambiguous response, inspect the authoritative state with a read tool before deciding to retry.
Do not interpret a stale list result as proof that a previous write failed; use a direct lookup or bounded re-check when available.
Finish only after the observable evidence is consistent with the requested final state.
